Create a standalone Shiny app for the dose-response module

Source: R/doseResponse_module_app.R
doseResponseApp.Rd

Convenience wrapper around VizModules::createModuleApp() that launches the dose-response module: a scatter plot of response versus dose (log10 x-axis) with a drc log-logistic model fitted as the curve. Irrelevant scatter plot tabs and inputs are hidden.

Usage

doseResponseApp(
  data_list = NULL,
  defaults = NULL,
  hide.inputs = NULL,
  hide.tabs = NULL
)

Arguments

data_list

An optional named list of dose-response data frames. If NULL (the default), list("dose_response" = dose_response) is used.

defaults

A named list of default values, merged over the module's dose-response defaults (user values win) and, with the example data, over the gallery's settings.

hide.inputs

A character vector of input IDs to hide. Their values are still initialized and used, but the controls are not shown in the UI.

hide.tabs

A character vector of tab names to hide. Inputs in these tabs are still initialized and used. NULL (the default) keeps the module's own default.

Value

A Shiny app object.

Details

When data_list is not provided, the app launches with the bundled dose_response example data, on the settings the module gallery (sciModuleGalleryApp()) opens this module on.

See also

doseResponseInputsUI(), doseResponseOutputUI(), doseResponseServer(), dose_response

Author

Jacob Martin

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
# Launch with the bundled example dose-response data:
app <- doseResponseApp()
if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app)
